tools.name: process_email_attachment_complete
tools.short_description: SMART bundled tool: Download email attachment → Auto-detect file type → Route to cloud platform tools (Excel/Word) OR vision processing (PDF/images) → Return structured data
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:

⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='process_email_attachment_complete', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

🤖 SMART BUNDLED TOOL - ONE CALL = COMPLETE WORKFLOW:
This tool automatically handles the COMPLETE email attachment processing workflow in a SINGLE call:

📥 BACKEND OPERATIONS (automatic):
1. Download attachment to temp directory (/tmp/outlook_attachments/ or /tmp/gmail_attachments/)
2. Auto-detect file type and size
3. INTELLIGENT ROUTING:
   - Excel/Word/Office docs → Upload to cloud (OneDrive or Google Drive) → Use platform tools (microsoft_excel_get_range, google_sheets_read_data) → Extract structured queryable data
   - PDF/Images → Use vision processing (process_outlook_attachment_for_ai or process_gmail_attachment_for_ai) → Return content blocks
   - CSV/TXT → Parse locally with Python → Return structured JSON
4. Auto-cleanup temp files
5. Return appropriate format (structured data JSON OR content blocks)

⚡ EFFICIENCY: 90% reduction in tool calls (8-12 API calls → 1 tool call)

✅ USE THIS TOOL WHEN:
- User asks to "open", "read", "analyze", or "process" an email attachment
- Need structured data from Excel/Word docs (queryable JSON, not just images)
- Want complete end-to-end attachment processing in one step
- Processing multiple attachments from same email (supports batch mode)

🎯 FILE TYPE ROUTING (automatic):
- .xlsx, .xls → Cloud upload → microsoft_excel_get_range → Returns: {rows: [...], columns: [...], formulas: [...]}
- .docx, .doc → Cloud upload → microsoft_word_read_content → Returns: {text: "...", paragraphs: [...], tables: [...]}
- .pdf → Vision processing → Returns: content_blocks with rendered pages
- .png, .jpg, .jpeg → Vision processing → Returns: content_blocks with native image analysis
- .csv, .txt → Local Python parsing → Returns: {data: [...], headers: [...]}

🔧 PROCESSING MODES:
- 'auto' (recommended): Backend intelligently routes based on file type, size, and user's cloud storage availability
- 'cloud_onedrive': Force upload to OneDrive temp folder → Use Microsoft platform tools
- 'cloud_gdrive': Force upload to Google Drive temp folder → Use Google platform tools
- 'vision': Force vision processing (PDF rendered as images, no structured data extraction)
- 'local_python': Force local Python parsing (CSV/TXT only, no cloud upload)

⚠️ CLOUD STORAGE REQUIREMENTS:
- OneDrive mode: Requires user to have Microsoft 365 OAuth connected
- Google Drive mode: Requires user to have Google Workspace OAuth connected
- Auto mode: Backend checks available credentials and selects best option

🗑️ AUTO-CLEANUP:
- Temp files deleted after processing
- Cloud temp folders auto-cleaned after 24 hours
- No manual cleanup needed

📊 RETURN FORMAT:
For structured data (Excel/Word/CSV):
{
  "success": true,
  "file_type": "excel",
  "processing_mode": "cloud_onedrive",
  "data": {...},  // Queryable structured data
  "cloud_file_id": "xyz" // Optional: Keep file in cloud for future reference
}

For vision processing (PDF/images):
{
  "success": true,
  "file_type": "pdf",
  "processing_mode": "vision",
  "content_blocks": [...] // Auto-injected into conversation context
}

Process complete email attachment workflow: download → intelligent routing → structured data extraction OR vision processing → cleanup.

After listing email attachments and user wants to see contents

Want complete workflow in one step (download + process + cleanup)

tools.name: process_local_file_universal
tools.short_description: SMART bundled tool: Process any local server file → Auto-detect type → Route to best processing method (cloud platform tools, vision, or local parsing) → Return structured data
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:

⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='process_local_file_universal', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

🤖 SMART BUNDLED TOOL - ONE CALL = COMPLETE WORKFLOW:
This tool automatically handles COMPLETE local file processing in a SINGLE call:

📥 BACKEND OPERATIONS (automatic):
1. Validate file path (security: /tmp/, whitelisted directories only)
2. Auto-detect file type, size, and format
3. INTELLIGENT ROUTING:
   - Excel/Word/Office docs → Upload to cloud → Platform tools → Structured queryable data
   - PDF/Images → Vision processing → Content blocks
   - CSV/TXT/JSON → Local Python parsing → Structured data
   - Large files (>100MB) → Stream processing with progress indicators
4. Optional: Keep in cloud or auto-cleanup
5. Return appropriate format (structured data JSON OR content blocks)

⚡ EFFICIENCY: 85% reduction in tool calls (5-8 API calls → 1 tool call)

✅ USE THIS TOOL WHEN:
- File is already on server filesystem (e.g., /tmp/uploads/file.xlsx)
- Need to process downloaded files from other sources
- Want intelligent routing without manually choosing processing method
- Processing server-side temp files or backend documents

🎯 FILE TYPE ROUTING (automatic):
- .xlsx, .xls → Cloud upload → microsoft_excel_get_range → Returns structured data with formulas
- .docx, .doc → Cloud upload → microsoft_word_read_content → Returns text + paragraphs + tables
- .pdf → Vision processing → Returns content blocks (rendered pages, can read text/charts)
- .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif → Vision processing → Returns content blocks (native image analysis)
- .csv → Local pandas parsing → Returns {data: [...], headers: [...], stats: {...}}
- .txt, .json, .xml → Local parsing → Returns structured content
- .zip, .tar.gz → Extract → Process contents recursively (if allowed)

🔧 PROCESSING MODES:
- 'auto' (recommended): Backend intelligently routes based on file type, size, cloud availability
- 'cloud_onedrive': Force OneDrive upload → Microsoft platform tools (requires M365 OAuth)
- 'cloud_gdrive': Force Google Drive upload → Google platform tools (requires GWorkspace OAuth)
- 'vision': Force vision processing (good for unknown formats, returns rendered content)
- 'local_python': Force local Python parsing (no cloud upload, works offline)

🔒 SECURITY:
- Path validation: Only allows /tmp/, /var/uploads/, and whitelisted directories
- File size limits: Warns for files >500MB, rejects >1GB
- Extension validation: Blocks executables (.exe, .dll, .sh, .bat)
- Content scanning: Auto-detects malware signatures in PDFs

⚠️ PATH REQUIREMENTS:
- Must be ABSOLUTE path on SERVER (e.g., C:/temp/uploads/file.pdf or /tmp/file.xlsx)
- NOT user's local computer path (this tool runs on backend server)
- Use forward slashes (/) or proper Windows backslashes (\\)

🗑️ AUTO-CLEANUP:
- Default: Keeps original file, deletes temp cloud uploads
- With delete_after=true: Deletes original file after processing
- Cloud temp folders auto-cleaned after 24 hours

📊 RETURN FORMAT:
For structured data:
{
  "success": true,
  "file_type": "excel",
  "file_path": "/tmp/file.xlsx",
  "processing_mode": "cloud_onedrive",
  "data": {...},  // Queryable structured data
  "metadata": {"rows": 500, "sheets": 3},
  "cloud_file_id": "xyz"  // If keep_in_cloud=true
}

For vision processing:
{
  "success": true,
  "file_type": "pdf",
  "file_path": "/tmp/report.pdf",
  "processing_mode": "vision",
  "content_blocks": [...],  // Auto-injected into conversation
  "metadata": {"pages": 12, "size_mb": 2.5}
}

💡 SMART FEATURES:
- Auto-retries with fallback modes if primary method fails
- Progress indicators for large files (>50MB)
- Batch mode: Can process multiple files in one call
- Cache: Repeated access to same file uses cached results (faster)

Process complete local file workflow: validate → detect type → intelligent routing → structured extraction OR vision processing → optional cleanup.
